items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, for Phantom Strike.
items.legacy_note: Sell it for Phantom Strike.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Stalker, vitality 4.8k at Enduring Speed.

items.name: Restorative Shot
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Berserker later.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Stalker completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 4 purchases
items.legacy_note: Sell it for Berserker.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Stalker completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Stalker completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 7200 souls (~7.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Melee Charge
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Stalker completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Stalker completes 4.8k weapon in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases
items.legacy_note: Shoulder Charge pins them into a wall, so the heavy always lands.

items.name: Stalker
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Sell it for your first counter.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Melee Lifesteal (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 2 purchases
items.legacy_note: Light punches and troopers trigger it too.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 9,600-28,000 (levels 16-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Shoulder Charge T3, Infernal Resilience T3, Seismic Impact T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Shoulder Charge, damage) grows from 53.1 to 126. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Spirit Snatch.

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Snatch, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Snatch, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Point Blank
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Spirit Strike (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 7,200 to 10,400 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 10,400 to 15,200 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Berserker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 15,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Sell Restorative Shot for this.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you. Takes vitality from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Get it earlier if most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,800 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Pop it as you ult in.

items.name: Phantom Strike
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: For the flyer or the one who keeps dashing away from your Charge.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Enduring Speed? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.
sections.desc: Dying after Enduring Speed? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Against gun heroes: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta, Infernus.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Against spirit heroes: Seven, Geist, Pocket, Kelvin.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slowing Hex, Infernus burn, Knockdown before it lands.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Against gun heroes who stand still and shoot you: Wraith, Haze, Bebop.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Against heroes who out-heal you: Rem, Geist, another Abrams.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Hunter's Aura for this.

items.name: Scourge
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Sell Spirit Snatch for this.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Shoulder Charge (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown. Takes vitality from 20,800 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Spirit Resilience for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 59 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Sell Stalker for this, or Spirit Resilience if it's gone.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Enduring Speed.
